title: Mails are not loaded in chronological order
creator: m.redmann
content: Hi, when loading my mails from Microsoft Outlook account they are not loaded correctly ordered. The first 100 mails are partly from this year and partly from 2004. If I want to see this year's mails I need to load the whole folder which is about 12,000 mails. That's too heavy and slows down everything. Can I avoid this behaviour? Maybe by copying all mails to a new folder to regain the correct order? Thanks & regards, Michael

title: Como meter o Yandex Mailo no Mozilla Thunderbird para Android?
creator: edlasiobenedito
content: Bom dia, eu sou usuário do Mozilla Thunderbird para Android, eu testei e funciona automaticamente nas contas do Gmail, Outlook,Yahoo!, Sapo Mailo. Tive de fazer configuração na conta do Mailo. Mas quanto tentei a conta do Yandex Mailo não conseguio iniciar sessão, alguém pode me ajudar.
